first.title: Case Western Reserve University - First-Year Applicants

intl.title: Case Western Reserve University - International Applicants

test_policy.notes: Case Western Reserve is test optional; SAT or ACT scores may be submitted if the applicant chooses.

requirements.notes: Common App or Coalition with Scoir. Required: official high school transcript, School Report, counselor recommendation, two teacher recommendations, an essay (all first-year students) and the $75 fee (waivers available). Music and music-education applicants need an Arts Supplement. Pre-Professional Scholars applicants write two additional essays plus an interview in late March if selected as a finalist. Applicants seeking need-based aid must indicate it on the application and submit financial aid documents for the application to be complete: non-U.S. residents submit the CSS Profile only (CSS code 1105); U.S. citizens and permanent residents submit FAFSA plus CSS Profile. The page does not state a year, so dates are taken as the current cycle.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I (binding)
deadlines.notes: Anticipated notification Dec 5; deposit due Dec 12; financial aid documents due Nov 15.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Anticipated notification Dec 19; reply by May 1; financial aid documents due Nov 15.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II (binding)
deadlines.notes: Anticipated notification Feb 6; deposit due 1 week after admission; financial aid documents due Jan 22.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Anticipated notification Mar 20; reply by May 1; financial aid documents due Feb 1. The separate Pre-Professional Scholars Program (conditional medical/dental admission) closes Dec 1 with notification Jan 30.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Automatically waived if you attended a school with English as the language of instruction for two years by graduation, score 630+ on the SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing section, or score 26+ on the ACT English section.

english.notes: For exams taken on or before January 20, 2026 (577 on the paper-based test).
For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026; includes Home Edition and Paper Edition.

aid.notes: The international page states financial aid is available to international students, all undergraduates are automatically evaluated for several scholarships (including full-tuition awards via scholarship competitions that need an essay), and CWRU awarded $213 million in institutional aid last year. Whether need is met in full for international students, and whether admission is need-blind, is not stated on the pages read, so intl_aid_policy is left unset.

toefl.note: TOEFL code not found on the admissions pages read.

tier_notes.nursing: Frances Payne Bolton School of Nursing is a top-15 nursing program.
